gloss.intro: Ko e ngaahi lea ʻoku ngāueʻaki ʻe he kau tohi polokalama (mo e ngaahi kautaha AI), ʻi he lea faingofua.
gloss.switch.help: Ko e ngaahi lea ʻoku laine toti ʻi lalo ʻoku ma'u ai ha fakamatala faingofua ʻi he taimi ʻoku ke tuku ai ʻa e māusi ki ai.
gloss.backlog.text: Ngaahi fakakaukau mo e ngāue te'eki palani. ʻIkai ha me'a ʻe fai ai kae ʻoua ke ʻave ki he Ke fai.
gloss.sprint.text: Ko ha vaha'a ngāue nounou (ʻuhinga ko ha uike pe ua) mo ha ngaahi kaati kuo loto taha ke fakaʻosi.
gloss.standup.text: Ko ha fetuʻutaki vave: ko e hā naʻe fai ʻe he mēmipa taki taha, ko e hā ʻe fai hoko, pea ko e hā ʻoku taʻofi ai.
gloss.bug.text: Ko ha me'a ʻoku ʻikai ngāue ʻo hangē ko e meʻa ʻoku totonu ke ngāue ai.
gloss.test.text: Feinga ki ha konga ngāue kuo ʻosi ke sivi pe ʻoku fai ʻa e me'a naʻe kole, kimuʻa pea ke fakamoʻoni.
gloss.commit.text: Ko ha tā kuo tauhi ʻo e koti, mo ha fakamatala nounou ʻo e me'a naʻe liliu. Te ke lava maʻu pē ʻo foki ki ha taha.
gloss.push.text: Fekau e ngaahi tā kuo tauhi (commits) mei he komipiuta ni ki he GitHub, ke tauhi mo vahevahe.
gloss.branch.text: Ko ha laine ngāue kehe ʻi he koti, ke lava ʻo fai ha ngaahi liliu taʻe ala ki he paaki tefito.
gloss.merge.text: Fakatahaʻi e ngaahi liliu ʻo ha branch ki he paaki tefito.
gloss.repo.text: Ko e folda ʻo e poloseki ʻo e koti mo hono hisitōlia kakato ʻo e ngaahi commit, ʻoku fa'a tauhi foki ʻi he GitHub.
gloss.refactor.text: Fakama'a e koti taʻe liliu e me'a ʻoku ne fai: ngaahi fail siʻi ange, ngaahi hingoa mahino ange, siʻi ange ʻa e toe fakahoko.
gloss.deploy.text: Fokotuʻu ha paaki foʻou ke moʻui, hangē ko ha sēvā ʻoku ngāueʻaki ai ʻe he kakai.
gloss.kanban.text: Ko ha laupapa mo e ngaahi kolomu (Ke fai, ʻOku fakahoko, Kuo fai) ʻoku ʻalu ai e ngaahi kaati mei toʻohema ki toʻomataʻu ʻi he taimi ʻoku fai ai e ngāue.
gloss.wip.text: Ngāue ʻoku fakahoko: ko e lahi taha ʻo e ngaahi kaati ʻe lava ke hao ʻi ha kolomu, ke fakaʻosi ʻe he kautaha e ngaahi me'a kimuʻa pea kamata ha toe.
gloss.pr.text: Kole ke vakaiʻi mo fakatahaʻi ʻa e ngaahi liliu ʻo ha branch ki he paaki tefito.
gloss.hook.text: Ko ha fekau siʻisiʻi ʻoku lele ʻiate ia ʻi ha taimi kuo fokotuʻu, hangē ko e ʻi he kamata ʻa ha sēsini AI, ke fanongo ʻa e kautaha ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamatala.
gloss.token.text: Ko e iuniti ʻoku lau ai e ngāueʻaki AI: ʻuhinga ko ha mataʻitohi siʻi ʻo e tohi kuo lau pe tohi. Token siʻi ange, palani lahi ange ʻoku toe.
gloss.agent.text: Ko ha AI ʻoku ngāue ʻiate ia ki ha ngāue: lau e koti, fai ha liliu, lele ha ngaahi sivi, pea lipooti mai.

tour.welcome.why: Ko e fakakaukau: ʻoku fai ʻe he ngaahi kautaha e ngāue faingataʻa siʻi, pea ʻoku ke sio pē ki he me'a ʻoku fiemaʻu ha tangata.
tour.rail.title: Hoʻo ngaahi poloseki
tour.rail.text: ʻApi, hoʻo puha fakamatala, talanoa mo e kau taki, pea ko e ʻaikoni ʻe taha ki he poloseki taki taha. Ko e taimana viole ʻoku ʻuhinga ia ʻoku ʻi ai ha me'a ʻoku tatali kiate koe. Toho e ngaahi ʻaikoni ke tuku ʻi hoʻo fakamālie.
tour.rail.short: Ngaahi poloseki ʻi he laine (ʻi lalo ʻi ha telefoni); ko e ngaahi taimana lanu viole ʻoku ʻuhinga ʻoku ʻi ai ha meʻa ʻoku tatali kiate koe.
tour.rail.why: Ko e sio pē taha ʻoku ne tala atu ʻa e feituʻu ʻoku fiemaʻu ai koe, taʻe fakaava ha me'a.
tour.inbox.title: Hoʻo puha fakamatala
tour.inbox.text: Ko e me'a kotoa ʻoku tatali kiate koe, ʻi he ngaahi poloseki kotoa: ngaahi fehuʻi, ngaahi ngāue ʻe lava pē ʻe koe ʻo fai, mo e ngaahi me'a ke sivi. Lomi ha chip ke sio ki he faʻahinga pē ko ia.
tour.inbox.short: Ko e me'a kotoa ʻoku tatali kiate koe, ʻi he feituʻu kotoa. Lomi ha chip ki ha faʻahinga ʻe taha.
tour.inbox.why: ʻOku ʻikai totonu ke ke ō ki he poloseki kotoa ke ʻilo e me'a ʻoku fiemaʻu koe.
tour.foryou.title: Maʻau
tour.foryou.text: ʻI ha laupapa, ko e kolomu ni ʻoku ne ʻi ai e me'a ʻoku tatali kiate koe ʻi he poloseki ko ia. Fakaava ha sivi, muimui ki hono ngaahi sitepu, pea Fakamoʻoni pe Fakafoki mo ha ʻuhinga.
tour.foryou.short: Ko e fokotuʻunga kaati ʻo e poloseki ni maʻau: sivi, pea Fakamoʻoni pe Fakafoki.
tour.foryou.why: ʻOku ʻikai fakaʻosi ʻe he ngaahi kautaha ʻenau ngāue ʻanautolu: ko koe ʻoku fakamoʻoni. ʻOku ne tauhi e tuʻunga lelei ʻi hoʻo nima.
tour.chat.title: Talanoa mo e kau taki
tour.chat.text: Fekau ha fakamatala ki he taki ʻo ha poloseki mo ha fakakaukau pe fehuʻi. ʻOku nau liliu e ngaahi fakakaukau ki he ngaahi kaati mo ha palani nounou, mo e ngaahi fakamau Fai maʻau.
tour.chat.short: Fekau ha fakamatala ki ha taki; te nau palani pea ke lomi Fai.
tour.chat.why: ʻIkai ha me'a ʻe langa kae ʻoua ke ke pehē Fai: ko koe ʻoku pule ki he me'a ʻoku hoko.
tour.setup.title: Fokotuʻu
tour.setup.text: Ho hingoa, lea, fōtunga mo e feituʻu ʻoku nofo ai e AI ʻi he komipiuta ni. ʻOku ʻi ai foki ha suiti ke fakamatala e ngaahi lea polokalama, mo e fakahinohino lea.
tour.setup.short: Ho ngaahi fokotuʻu, lea mo e tohi fakahā ʻo e ngaahi lea tekinikale. ʻI ha telefoni ʻoku ʻi lalo ʻi he lisi ʻi ʻolunga.
trial.h: 🧪 Feinga ko ha tokotaha ngāueʻaki foʻou
trial.help: Ko ha kopi foʻou, maha, ʻo e AI-gile ʻi hono uinitou ʻaʻana (localhost:4400), mo ha ngaahi poloseki fakatātā ʻe tolu ke kumi pea ko ha kautaha fakatātā ʻoku ne tali koe. Sio pe ko e hā e me'a ʻoku sio ki ai ha kaumeʻa ʻi heʻene lele ʻuluaki. ʻIkai ala ki hoʻo laupapa moʻoni; ʻikai ha AI, ʻikai ha totongi.

gloss.title: 📖 Ngaahi foʻi lea kuo fakamatalaʻi
gloss.about: Ko e ngaahi foʻi lea te ke fetaulaki mo ia ʻi he AI-gile, ʻi ha lea faingofua: langa ia, liliu ia ʻi he malu, tauhi ke ngāue maʻá e kakai ʻoku nau ngāueʻaki, mo ngāue fakataha ko ha timi mo e AI.
gloss.about.noai: Ko e ngaahi foʻi lea te ke fetaulaki mo ia ʻi he AI-gile, ʻi ha lea faingofua: langa ia, liliu ia ʻi he malu, tauhi ke ngāue maʻá e kakai ʻoku nau ngāueʻaki, mo ngāue fakataha ko ha timi.
gloss.g.team: 🤝 Ngāue ko ha timi (pea mo e AI)
gloss.qa.text: Ko e fakanounou ʻo e quality assurance: ko e ngaahi sivi ʻoku fai ʻe ia pē kimuʻa pea hū ha meʻa ki he laine. ʻOka kulokula ʻa e QA, kuo ʻi ai ha meʻa naʻe tō, pea ʻe ʻikai lava ke hū ki he laine kae ʻoua ke fakatonutonu.
gloss.release.text: Ko ha kulupu ngāue kuo ʻosi kuo fakahingoa ʻoku hū fakataha ki he laine, mo ha ngaahi fakamatala nounou ki he meʻa naʻe liliu. ʻOku tohi ʻe he 🚀 Ngaahi tukuange ʻa e ngaahi fakamatala mei he ngaahi kaati kuo ʻosi.
gloss.rollback.text: Foki ki he paaki fakamuimui naʻe ngāue lelei ʻi he taimi ʻoku fakatupu palopalema ai ha paaki foʻou. ʻI he AI-gile ʻoku ne ngaohi ha lisi sivi ʻo e ngaahi sitepu ke toe fakafoki naʻe tohi ʻi he liliu taki taha.
gloss.live.text: Ko e paaki moʻoni ʻoku ngāueʻaki ʻe he kakai, ʻo kehe mei ha kopi ke ʻahiʻahi ai ha ngaahi meʻa. ʻOku ui foki ia ʻe he kau fakatupulaki ko e production.
gloss.change.text: Ko ha liliu kuo palani ki ha meʻa ʻoku falala ki ai ʻa e kakai, ʻoku tohi ʻuluaki: ko e hā, ko e hā hono ʻuhinga, ko e fakatuʻutāmaki, ʻafē, pea mo e founga ke toe fakafoki ai. Kamata ʻaki ʻa e 🔀 Kole ha liliu.
gloss.risk.text: Ko ha meʻa ʻe ala hala, kuo fakamaaka ʻo fakatatau ki hono ngalingali mo e kovi ʻo ka hoko. ʻOku tauhi ʻe he ⚠️ Ngaahi fakatuʻutāmaki ʻi ha lisi pē ʻe taha, ko e maaka māʻolunga taha ʻi muʻa, taki taha mo ha ʻaho ke toe vakai ai.
gloss.chgwin.text: Ko e ngaahi taimi ʻoku ngofua ai ke hū ʻa e ngaahi liliu ki he laine, hangē ko ha efiafi Tūsite longolongo. ʻI tuʻa ʻi ha taimi liliu ʻe ʻikai lava ke fakaʻosi ha kaati liliu, tukukehe kapau ko ha meʻa fakavavevave.
gloss.gonogo.text: Ko ha fili vave kimuʻa siʻi pea hū ha liliu ki he laine: ko e tokotaha kotoa pē ʻoku totonu ke ne fakangofua ʻoku ne pehē ʻAlu pe ʻIkai ʻalu. ʻOku hoko atu pē ʻo ka nau loto taha.
gloss.approval.text: Tatali ki ha ʻio kimuʻa pea kamata ʻa e ngāue. Ko ha kaati ʻoku fokotuʻu ʻe ha kaumeʻa, pe ko ha liliu, ʻoku tatali ʻi he ✅ Ngaahi fakangofua kae ʻoua ke ke fakangofua pe fakafisi.
gloss.quiettime.text: Ko ha vahaʻa taimi, hangē ko ha stream, ha fakahāhā pe ko e pō, ʻoku ʻikai ha meʻa ʻe hū ai ki he laine. ʻOku hoko atu ʻa e ngāue mo e sivi ʻa e ngaahi timi, ka ʻoku tatali ʻa e hū ki he laine kae ʻoua ke ʻosi. ʻI ha ngaahi feituʻu kehe ʻoku ui ia ko e change freeze.
gloss.service.text: Ko ha meʻa naʻa ke langa ʻoku falala ki ai ʻa e kakai, hangē ko ha uepisaiti pe ha ʻapi, ʻoku tokangaʻi ke hoko atu ʻene ngāue. Fakamaʻaka ʻa e “Ko e poloseki ni ko ha sēvesi” pea fakahā ʻa e meʻa ʻoku ne foaki, ko hai ʻoku ngāueʻaki ia, mo hai ʻoku tokanga.
gloss.uptime.text: Ko ha sivi ʻoku fai ʻe ia pē, ʻi he miniti siʻi kotoa pē, pe ʻoku kei tali mai hoʻo sēvesi. Kapau ʻe tō ʻo liunga lahi hokohoko, ʻe fakaava ʻe he AI-gile ha kaati meʻa fakatuʻupakē ʻiate ia pē.
gloss.statuspage.text: Ko ha peesi fakakātoa ʻoku ne fakahā pe ʻoku ngāue ha sēvesi (lanu mata, lanu moli pe kulokula) mo e ongoongo fakamuimui taha, koeʻuhi ke lava ʻe he kakai ʻoku nau ngāueʻaki ʻo vakai kae ʻikai fehuʻi.
gloss.incident.text: Ko ha meʻa kuo maumau ʻi he taimi ni maʻá e kakai ʻoku nau ngāueʻaki, hangē ko e ʻikai ngāue ʻa e uepisaiti. ʻOku puna ki muʻa ʻi he laine ha kaati 🔥 meʻa fakatuʻupakē: ko hono toe fakangāueʻi ʻoku ʻuluaki.
gloss.major.text: Ko ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē lahi: tokolahi ʻoku uesia, pe ʻoku ʻi he fakatuʻutāmaki ʻa e paʻanga pe ngaahi fakamatala. ʻOku tuku ʻe ha meʻa lomiʻi pē ʻe taha ʻa e ngaahi timi kotoa ki ai (ngāue fakataha), ʻoku ueʻi ʻa e tokotaha ʻoku tokanga, pea kole ha ongoongo tuʻunga ʻi he miniti ʻe 30 kotoa pē.
gloss.oncall.text: Ko e hoko ko e tokotaha ʻoku tali ʻi he taimi ʻoku maumau ai ha meʻa, naʻa mo e pō. ʻOku ʻi ai ʻi he sēvesi taki taha ha mēmipa timi ʻoku tokanga ʻoku ʻuluaki ueʻi ki hono ngaahi meʻa fakatuʻupakē.
gloss.replyby.text: Ko e fuoloa ʻe lava ke tatali ai ha kaati ki ha ʻuluaki tali, hangē ko e houa ʻe taha ki ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē. Hili iá ʻoku maʻu ʻe ia ha uasi kulokula, koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻa ngalo fakalongolongo ha meʻa. ʻOku ui foki ko e taumuʻa tali.
gloss.postmortem.also: postmortem,toe vakai hili ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē
gloss.postmortem.text: Ko ha toe vakai nounou hili ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē: ko e hā naʻe hoko, ko e hā naʻe tokoni, pea ko e hā ke liliu, ʻo ʻikai tukuakiʻi ha taha. ʻE ʻikai lava ke tāpuni ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē ʻo ʻikai ha taha.
gloss.problem.text: Ko e tupuʻanga fufū ʻi mui ʻi ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē ʻe taha pe lahi ange. ʻOku tānaki fakataha ʻe ha kaati 🧩 palopalema ʻa e ngaahi meʻa fakatuʻupakē ʻoku toe foki mai, koeʻuhi ke ʻilo ʻa e tupuʻanga pea fakatonutonu taʻengata.
gloss.rootcause.text: Ko e ʻuhinga moʻoni naʻe maumau ai ha meʻa, ʻikai ko e meʻa pē naʻa ke sio ki ai ʻoku hala. Fakatonutonu ʻa e tupuʻanga pea ʻe tuku ʻa e toe foki mai ʻa e meʻa fakatuʻupakē.
gloss.workaround.text: Ko ha founga ke tauhi ke ngāue ʻa e ngaahi meʻa kae ʻoua ke mateuteu ʻa e fakatonutonu moʻoni, hangē ko hono toe kamata ha meʻa ʻi he taimi ʻoku piki ai. ʻOku tohi ia ʻi he kaati palopalema koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻa toe fiemaʻu ke kumi ʻe ha taha.
gloss.knownerror.text: Ko ha palopalema ʻoku mahino hono tupuʻanga pea ʻoku ʻi ai hano founga fakataimi, ka ʻoku teʻeki fakatonutonu. ʻOku lisi ʻe he 🧩 Ngaahi hala ʻoku ʻiloa, koeʻuhi ke ngāueʻaki ʻe he tokotaha kotoa ʻa e founga fakataimi kae ʻikai toe keli.
gloss.runbook.text: Ko ha ngaahi fakahinohino sitepu ki he sitepu ke fakatonutonu ha faʻahinga palopalema ʻoku ʻiloa, koeʻuhi ke fai tatau mo vave ʻi he taimi kotoa pē. Hili ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē lahi ʻe lava ʻe he timi ʻo fokotuʻu atu ha taha ke ke OK.
gloss.backup.text: Ko ha kopi kuo tauhi ʻo hoʻo ngaahi fakamatala mei muʻa, ke falala ki ai ʻo kapau ʻe mole pe maumau ha meʻa. ʻOku ngaohi ʻe he AI-gile ha kopi maluʻi ʻo hoʻo ngaahi papa ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē.
gloss.restore.text: Toe fakafoki mai ʻa e ngaahi fakamatala mei ha kopi maluʻi. ʻOku mahuʻinga moʻoni pē ha kopi maluʻi ʻo ka ke ʻilo ʻe lava ke toe fakafoki, ko ia ʻoku ʻaonga ke ʻahiʻahi ʻi he taimi ʻe niʻihi.
gloss.dod.word: Ko e fakamatala ʻo e ʻOsi
gloss.dod.also: Definition of Done,Ko e fakamatala ʻo e Mateuteu,Definition of Ready
gloss.dod.text: Ko e lisi sivi nounou ʻa e timi ki he ʻuhinga ʻo e “ʻosi”, hangē ko e kuo sivi mo fakamatalaʻi, kimuʻa pea ʻoatu ha kaati kiate koe. Ko hono māhanga, ko e fakamatala ʻo e Mateuteu, ʻoku ne fakahā ʻa e taimi ʻoku mahino feʻunga ai ha kaati ke kamata.
gloss.testpile.text: Ko e ngaahi kaati kuo ʻosi ʻoku tatali ke ke ʻahiʻahi, taha ki he taha. Tali ha taha pe fakafoki mo ha fakamatala, pea hoko mai ʻa e hoko.
gloss.retro.text: Ko ha toe vakai ki he founga ʻoku ngāue ai ʻa e timi, ke loto taha ki ha meʻa ʻe taha ke fai lelei ange. ʻI he AI-gile ʻoku fokotuʻu ʻe ha toe vakai ha liliu ki he founga ngāue ʻa e timi, pea ʻoku ke pehē Fai pe ʻIkai ʻi he taimi ni.
gloss.peerreview.text: Ko ha ongo mata hono ua: ʻoku sivi ʻe ha AI kehe ʻa e ngāue ʻa e kaati taki taha kimuʻa pea hoko kiate koe, koeʻuhi ke siʻi ange ʻa e ngaahi hala ʻoku hao atu.
gloss.swarm.text: Nima kotoa ki he ngāue: ʻoku tuku ʻe he timi kotoa ʻa e ngāue kehe ke tokoni ki ha poloseki fakavavevave ʻe taha kae ʻoua ke lelei. ʻOku tatali ʻa e ngaahi poloseki kehe ʻi he lolotonga ko iá.
gloss.scrummaster.text: Ko e tokotaha ʻoku ne tauhi ke hoko atu ʻa e ngāue: ʻoku ne sio ki he ngaahi kaati kuo piki, ʻoku ne fakaloto lahi ʻa e ngaahi timi pea fakamanatu atu kiate koe ʻa e meʻa ʻoku tatali. ʻI he AI-gile ʻoku fai ʻeni ʻe he Lead Scrum Master ʻi he poloseki kotoa pē.
gloss.scrummaster.text.noai: Ko e tokotaha ʻoku ne tauhi ke hoko atu ʻa e ngāue: ʻoku ne sio ki he ngaahi kaati kuo piki pea fakamanatu atu kiate koe ʻa e meʻa ʻoku tatali. ʻO ʻikai ha AI ʻoku ngāue ʻaki ʻa e ngaahi fekau paú, hangē ko hono fokotuʻutuʻu ʻa e Ke fai.
